description: This is a PHP class named SystemCheck within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. It performs various system and environment checks such as PHP version, database compatibility, directory permissions, and extension availability to ensure that the system meets the requirements for OrangeHRM installation and operation.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: A utility class for verifying system environment and configuration prerequisites for the OrangeHRM system installation, including checking PHP version, database support, extension availability, and directory permissions.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version falls within the acceptable range specified in system requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Verifies that the MySQL client version is compatible with system requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL server version meets system requirements.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Checks if the InnoDB storage engine is supported and enabled in the database.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Detects the web server software (e.g., Apache, Nginx) and verifies compatibility.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks if the configuration directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks if the cache directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks if the log directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks if the crypto keys directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Checks if the PHP session maximum idle time is within acceptable limits.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Verifies that the PHP 'register_globals' setting is turned off for security.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Checks and reports the memory limit allocated to PHP scripts.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if the cURL extension is enabled in PHP.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SimpleXML extension and its dependencies are loaded.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the PHP Zip extension is loaded.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the GD image processing extension is enabled.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the Intl extension for internationalization is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the PDO extension is loaded.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the PDO MySQL extension is loaded.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is available for directory services.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the OpenSSL extension is enabled for SSL/TLS support.
